name: sqrail-site
description: Validation and Cloudflare deployment tooling for the sqrail documentation site

scripts.format: prettier --write .htmlvalidate.json package.json README.md docs/README.md docs/AGENT_INTEGRATION.md docs/DEPLOYMENT.md docs/TESTING.md site/index.html site/docs/index.html site/404.html site/styles.css site/app.js wrangler.jsonc
scripts.format:check: prettier --check .htmlvalidate.json package.json README.md docs/README.md docs/AGENT_INTEGRATION.md docs/DEPLOYMENT.md docs/TESTING.md site/index.html site/docs/index.html site/404.html site/styles.css site/app.js wrangler.jsonc
scripts.site:check: npm run format:check && npm run site:html && npm run site:js && npm run cloudflare:check
